paragraphs.en: 📖 RuFlo Explained — Build an AI Team That Plans, Remembers, Tests, and Improves A 14-chapter guide: from the basic idea to a first useful task, then memory, agent teams, plugins, cost and verification.
paragraphs.zh:
📖 RuFlo 详解 — 构建一个会规划、记忆、测试并持续改进的 AI 团队
一份 14 章指南：从基本理念到第一个实用任务，随后介绍记忆、智能体团队、插件、成本与验证。

paragraphs.en: Agent = Model + Harness. The model writes; the harness gives it tools, memory, loops, sandboxes, and controls so it can actually work. Ruflo is the harness — the execution layer around Claude Code and Codex that adds 100+ specialized agents, coordinated swarms, self-learning memory, federated comms across machines, and enterprise security guardrails. So agents don't just run, they collaborate.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体 = 模型 + 框架。 模型负责生成；框架为它提供工具、记忆、循环、沙箱和控制机制，使它能够真正开展工作。 Ruflo 就是这样一个框架——围绕 Claude Code 和 Codex 的执行层，它提供 100 多个专用智能体、协同的智能体集群、自学习记忆、跨机器的联邦通信，以及企业级安全护栏。 因此智能体不只是运行，它们还能协作。

paragraphs.en: One npx ruflo init gives Claude Code a nervous system: agents self-organize into swarms, learn from every task, remember across sessions, and — with federation — securely talk to agents on other machines without leaking data. You keep writing code. Ruflo handles the coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 只需一条 npx ruflo init，就能为 Claude Code 装上神经系统：智能体自组织成集群，从每个任务中学习，跨会话记忆，并且——通过联邦机制——在不泄露数据的前提下安全地与其他机器上的智能体通信。你只需继续写代码。 Ruflo 负责协调工作。

paragraphs.en: Let Claude drive. You set the limits. Enable Settings → Claude control to navigate and run console actions. Choose read , write , manage or full , with ask or auto approval. The current default is read + ask ; raising the level is your choice. Actions above your permission level are refused, and network, spending and destructive actions require confirmation even in auto . Review the live action log or press Take back control to stop Claude control. Details .
paragraphs.zh: 让 Claude 来驾驶，边界由你来定。 启用「设置 → Claude 控制」以进行导航并执行控制台操作。 可选择 read（读取）、write（写入）、manage（管理）或 full（完全），并搭配 ask（询问）或 auto（自动）审批。 当前默认为 read + ask；是否提高权限级别由你决定。 超出你权限级别的操作会被拒绝，而且在 auto 模式下，涉及网络、花费和破坏性的操作仍需确认。 可查看实时操作日志，或按下「收回控制权」来停止 Claude 控制。详情见此。

paragraphs.en: Install the mods from the ruflo marketplace (Claude Code 2.1.287 or later; mods run with your account's permissions and are not sandboxed, so read the code first):
paragraphs.zh: 从 ruflo 市场安装模组（需要 Claude Code 2.1.287 或更高版本；模组会以你账户的权限运行，且不在沙箱中，因此请先阅读代码）：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo /plugin install ruflo-console@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-mods@ruflo /reload-plugins ruflo-console is the cockpit above, ruflo-mods routes prompts and enforces policy in-process, ruflo-swarm shows the swarm in a pane, and ruflo-ruos adds the ruOS status segment. Open /plugin to confirm they appear in the active mods line. Inside the console, /ruflo market is the Plugin Catalog: every ruflo plugin, mod and skill with what it ships, and buttons to install, enable, disable and update (each asks first).

paragraphs.en: # Add the marketplace /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo # Install core + any plugins you need /plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-swarm@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-rag-memory@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-neural-trader@ruflo This adds slash commands and agent definitions. ruflo-core (installed above) does register its own MCP server on install — its tools are callable as mcp__plugin_ruflo-core_ruflo__* (e.g. mcp__plugin_ruflo-core_ruflo__memory_store ), not the bare memory_store / swarm_init / agent_spawn names the CLI-track scaffold uses. Other plugins generally don't ship their own MCP server. For the full loop with the CLI-track tool names, use Path B below.
paragraphs.zh: # 添加市场 /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo # 安装核心插件及你需要的其他插件 /plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-swarm@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-rag-memory@ruflo /plugin install ruflo-neural-trader@ruflo 这会添加斜杠命令与智能体定义。ruflo-core（如上安装）在安装时确实会注册自己的 MCP 服务器——其工具以 mcp__plugin_ruflo-core_ruflo__* 的形式调用（例如 mcp__plugin_ruflo-core_ruflo__memory_store），而不是 CLI 路线脚手架所使用的裸名称 memory_store / swarm_init / agent_spawn。 其他插件通常不自带 MCP 服务器。 要使用 CLI 路线的工具名称完成完整流程，请参见下方的路径 B。

paragraphs.en: Slack gave teams channels. Federation gives agents the same thing — shared workspaces across trust boundaries , where agents on different machines, orgs, or cloud regions can discover each other, prove who they are, and collaborate on tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Slack 为团队提供了频道。 联邦为智能体提供了同样的东西——跨越信任边界的共享工作区，让不同机器、组织或云区域上的智能体能够相互发现、证明自己的身份，并协作完成任务。

sents.en: Slack gave teams channels.
sents.zh: Slack 为团队提供了频道。

sents.en: Federation gives agents the same thing — shared workspaces across trust boundaries , where agents on different machines, orgs, or cloud regions can discover each other, prove who they are, and collaborate on tasks.
sents.zh: 联邦为智能体提供了同样的东西——跨越信任边界的共享工作区，让不同机器、组织或云区域上的智能体能够相互发现、证明自己的身份，并协作完成任务。

paragraphs.en: The difference: some channels are trusted, some aren't. @claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation handles that automatically. Your agents join a federation, get verified via mTLS + ed25519, and start exchanging work — with PII stripped before anything leaves your node and every message auditable. Untrusted agents can still participate at lower privilege: they see discovery info, not your memory. As they prove reliable, trust upgrades. If they misbehave, they get downgraded instantly — no human in the loop required.
paragraphs.zh: 区别在于：有些渠道是可信的，有些则不可信。@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation 会自动处理这一点。 你的智能体加入一个联邦，通过 mTLS + ed25519 完成验证，然后开始交换工作——在任何数据离开你的节点之前，个人身份信息（PII）都会被剥离，并且每条消息都可审计。 不可信的智能体仍可以以较低权限参与：它们能看到发现信息，但看不到你的记忆。 随着它们证明自己可靠，信任等级会提升。 如果它们行为不当，会被立即降级——无需人工介入。

sents.en: Untrusted agents can still participate at lower privilege: they see discovery info, not your memory.
sents.zh: 不可信的智能体仍可以以较低权限参与：它们能看到发现信息，但看不到你的记忆。

sents.en: As they prove reliable, trust upgrades.
sents.zh: 随着它们证明自己可靠，信任等级会提升。

sents.en: If they misbehave, they get downgraded instantly — no human in the loop required.
sents.zh: 如果它们行为不当，会被立即降级——无需人工介入。

paragraphs.en: You don't configure handshakes or manage certificates. You federation init , federation join , and your agents start talking. The protocol handles identity, the PII pipeline handles data safety, and the audit trail handles compliance.
paragraphs.zh: 你无需配置握手或管理证书。 你执行 federation init、federation join，你的智能体就开始通信了。 协议负责身份，PII 管道负责数据安全，审计追踪负责合规。

paragraphs.en: # Team A: initialize federation and generate keypair npx claude-flow@latest federation init # Team A: join Team B's federation endpoint npx claude-flow@latest federation join wss://team-b.example.com:8443 # Team A: send a task — PII is stripped automatically before it leaves npx claude-flow@latest federation send --to team-b --type task-request \ --message " Analyze transaction patterns for account anomalies " # Team A: check peer trust levels and session health npx claude-flow@latest federation status See issue #1669 for the complete architecture, trust model, and implementation roadmap.
paragraphs.zh: # Team A：初始化联邦并生成密钥对 npx claude-flow@latest federation init # Team A：加入 Team B 的联邦端点 npx claude-flow@latest federation join wss://team-b.example.com:8443 # Team A：发送任务 —— PII（个人身份信息）会在离开前被自动剥离 npx claude-flow@latest federation send --to team-b --type task-request \ --message " Analyze transaction patterns for account anomalies " # Team A：检查对等方的信任级别与会话健康状态 npx claude-flow@latest federation status 完整的架构、信任模型与实施路线图请参见 issue #1669。

paragraphs.en: # Claude Code plugin /plugin install ruflo-federation@ruflo # Or via CLI npx claude-flow@latest plugins install @claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation Claude Code: With vs Without Ruflo Capability Claude Code Alone + Ruflo Agent Collaboration Isolated, no shared context Swarms with shared memory and consensus Coordination Manual orchestration Queen-led hierarchy (Raft, Byzantine, Gossip) Memory Session-only HNSW vector memory with sub-ms retrieval Learning Static behavior SONA self-learning with pattern matching Task Routing You decide Intelligent routing (89% accuracy) Background Workers None 12 auto-triggered workers LLM Providers Anthropic only 5 providers with failover Security Standard CVE-hardened with AIDefence Architecture overview User --> Claude Code / CLI | v Orchestration Layer (MCP Server, Router, 27 Hooks) | v Swarm Coordination (Queen, Topology, Consensus) | v 100+ Specialized Agents (coder, tester, reviewer, architect, security...) | v Memory & Learning (AgentDB, HNSW, SONA, ReasoningBank) | v LLM Providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Cohere, Ollama) Documentation
paragraphs.zh: # Claude Code 插件 /plugin install ruflo-federation@ruflo # 或通过 CLI npx claude-flow@latest plugins install @claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation Claude Code：使用与不使用 Ruflo 的对比 能力 仅用 Claude Code + Ruflo 智能体协作 孤立运行，无共享上下文 具有共享内存和共识机制的群体 协调 手动编排 由女王节点主导的层级结构（Raft、拜占庭、Gossip） 内存 仅会话内有效 HNSW 向量内存，亚毫秒级检索 学习 静态行为 SONA 自学习与模式匹配 任务路由 由你决定 智能路由（89% 准确率） 后台工作进程 无 12 个自动触发的工作进程 LLM 提供商 仅 Anthropic 5 家提供商，支持故障转移 安全性 标准 已强化 CVE 防护，配备 AIDefence 架构概览 用户 --> Claude Code / CLI | v 编排层（MCP 服务器、路由器、27 个钩子） | v 群体协调（女王节点、拓扑结构、共识机制） | v 100+ 专用智能体（编码、测试、审查、架构、安全……） | v 内存与学习（AgentDB、HNSW、SONA、ReasoningBank） | v LLM 提供商（Claude、GPT、Gemini、Cohere、Ollama） 文档
